text: There is an underground pool of oil (near the surface of the Earth). The ground is 5 feet above the top of the pool and 9 feet above the bottom of the pool. The density of the oil is 50 Ib per cubic foot. A horizontal slice of the oil k feet above the bottom of the pool has area A(h) = h? square feet. The work Wrequired to pump the oil to the surface can be expressed as an integral fﬂb f(h)dhwith a < b. (a) What is the value of the lower limit of integration, a? (b) What is the value of the upper limit of integration, b? (c) What is the integrand, f(h)? (d) What are the units of W?
